changeSet.comment: nexus.reaper_expire_client_quarantine: the engine's expiry of the client-moved (not reaper-owned) rows of a quarantine sibling whose origin_collection tag names a registered LIVE origin with catalog content_type knowledge (the sibling itself registered with content_type knowledge and lifecycle_state quarantine), past the row's own quarantined_at plus retention, never a chash the origin's manifest still names, at most p_row_limit per call, no fraction floor, one reaper_expire_client_quarantine gc_audit row per call that deletes. Returns expired and protected_count. Refuses a malformed cutoff. Does nothing for any other sibling or origin.

rollback.sql: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.reaper_expire_client_quarantine(text, text, text, text, int);
